title: 10 Best HR Help Desk Software for Microsoft Teams (2027)
summary: Compare the 10 best HR help desk software tools for Microsoft Teams in 2027, including ticketing, AI automation, and employee support.
body_markdown:
Microsoft Teams is a widely used collaboration platform that organizations rely on for workplace communication, meetings, and internal coordination. HR teams now field employee requests directly in Teams channels and DMs, from benefits questions and PTO inquiries to payroll concerns, onboarding tasks, and sensitive employee relations matters. The challenge is not whether employees will ask for help in Teams. The challenge is whether HR can turn those conversations into structured, private, and trackable work without forcing employees into a separate portal.


A strong[HR service desk](https://unthread.io/solutions/hr-service-desk?ref=unthread.io) built for Microsoft Teams helps HR teams respond where employees already work while maintaining privacy, ownership, SLAs, and reporting. The right platform reduces context-switching for employees and HR staff, supports confidential request handling, and automates recurring Tier 1 questions to reduce administrative work.


## **Key Takeaways**


- HR teams should prioritize Microsoft Teams help desk tools that support[private employee requests](https://unthread.io/solutions/hr-service-desk?ref=unthread.io) , structured ownership, routing, automation, and reporting.
- [Unthread](https://unthread.io/products/slack-support?ref=unthread.io) supports organizations using Slack as their primary collaboration platform, offering Teams intake support alongside Slack-native ticketing, private request handling, and[purpose-built AI agents](https://unthread.io/products/agentic-ai?ref=unthread.io) across HR and other internal teams.
- Microsoft Teams help desk tools should integrate with existing Microsoft 365 applications to streamline employee requests, collaboration, and support workflows.
- Enterprise HR teams should prioritize service management platforms with governance controls, configurable approval workflows, and[automation capabilities](https://unthread.io/products/automations?ref=unthread.io) that support cross-departmental operations.
- Teams-integrated help desk tools should convert employee questions into structured workflows while maintaining confidentiality through[private ticketing](https://unthread.io/solutions/hr-service-desk?ref=unthread.io) .
- Effective HR support combines accessible request intake with a[self-learning knowledge base](https://unthread.io/products/knowledge-base?ref=unthread.io) , automated responses, and private workflows for sensitive employee matters.


## **What HR Teams Should Look for in an HR Help Desk for Teams**


HR support has different requirements from customer service or general IT ticketing. A benefits question, payroll concern, parental leave discussion, or employee relations issue needs more privacy than a standard software access request. At the same time, employees still expect fast answers from the same place they already work.


A strong Microsoft Teams help desk for HR should help teams:


- Convert Teams messages, DMs, and channel posts into tickets
- Route requests by topic, team, urgency, or employee context
- Keep sensitive matters private with confidential ticketing flows
- Automate recurring Tier 1 questions with purpose-built AI agents
- Build a reusable[knowledge base](https://unthread.io/products/knowledge-base?ref=unthread.io) from resolved requests
- Track SLAs and ownership across HR queues
- Connect with HRIS, identity, ITSM, and internal operations tools through relevant[integration capabilities](https://unthread.io/products/integrations?ref=unthread.io)


The most practical systems let HR teams keep everyday request intake simple while adding structure behind the scenes.


## **1) Unthread: Purpose-built AI agent for Slack-native HR support**


[Unthread](https://unthread.io/products/slack-support?ref=unthread.io) turns Slack into a structured internal help desk with conversational ticketing, purpose-built AI agents, private workflows, and automation. It also supports request intake through Microsoft Teams, email, and web chat, while its core ticketing and workflow management capabilities are built natively for Slack.


### **Why it fits HR teams**


Unthread supports HR, IT, finance, procurement, legal, and workplace operations. HR teams can manage employee requests involving payroll, benefits, leave, onboarding, and offboarding through structured ticketing and automated routing.


Employees can submit general questions in a Slack channel like #hr-help, while sensitive matters can move into private ticketing workflows to maintain confidentiality.


### **HR-relevant capabilities**


- [Purpose-built AI agents](https://unthread.io/products/agentic-ai?ref=unthread.io) **:** Automate routine requests and ticket resolution across departments.
- [Private ticketing](https://unthread.io/solutions/hr-service-desk?ref=unthread.io) **:** Manage sensitive HR requests involving payroll, benefits, leave, and employee relations.
- [Workflow automation](https://unthread.io/products/automations?ref=unthread.io) **:** Streamline recurring Tier 1 requests, approvals, escalations, and follow-ups.
- [Self-learning knowledge base](https://unthread.io/products/knowledge-base?ref=unthread.io) **:** Identify recurring questions and generate draft help articles from resolved tickets.
- [AI analytics](https://unthread.io/products/analytics?ref=unthread.io) **:** Track request trends, bottlenecks, and automation opportunities.


Unthread also helps HR coordinate cross-departmental workflows, such as onboarding, equipment provisioning, system access, and payroll setup, while keeping requests organized and trackable.


## **2) ServiceNow HR Service Delivery**


ServiceNow HR Service Delivery is an enterprise HR service management platform for large organizations with complex employee service, compliance, and workflow requirements.


### **Primary Focus**


ServiceNow HRSD is often considered when HR service delivery needs to operate across multiple regions, policies, approval chains, and enterprise systems. It is a practical consideration for companies with established ServiceNow environments and dedicated platform administration.


### **Key Features**


- Employee service center and HR case management
- Workflow design for approvals, routing, and escalations
- Knowledge management for employee self-service
- Connections with Workday, SAP SuccessFactors, Microsoft Dynamics
- Role-based controls for sensitive employee information
- Teams integration via Employee Center app


## **3) Freshservice**


Freshservice is Freshworks' IT service management platform and is often evaluated by internal teams that want structured service desk workflows.


### **Primary Focus**


Freshservice is relevant for organizations where HR support overlaps with IT service management, onboarding workflows, employee assets, and internal service catalogs. It can support internal operations where IT owns many employee-facing service processes.


### **Key Features**


- Service request management and employee portals
- Workflow automation for internal approvals
- Servicebot for Teams (native bot from Teams App Store)
- One-click approvals directly from Teams
- Freddy AI Agent for conversational self-service
- Ticket collaboration channels (create dedicated Teams channels per ticket)


## **4) Jira Service Management**


Jira Service Management, together with Atlassian Assist, supports conversational ticketing for teams already using Atlassian tools.


### **Primary Focus**


Jira Service Management is viable when HR requests need to connect with Jira Service Management or when the company already uses Atlassian for IT, operations, and knowledge management. Atlassian Assist can help convert Teams messages into service requests tied to JSM workflows.


### **Key Features**


- Native Teams integration via Atlassian ChatOps app
- Alert notifications routed to Teams channels (filterable)
- AI virtual agent inside Teams
- On-call schedule management from Teams
- Knowledge management through Confluence
- Free plan available with limited features


## **5) Desk365**


Desk365 is a Microsoft Teams-integrated help desk that supports ticket management and agent workflows within the Teams environment.


### **Primary Focus**


Desk365 can be useful for organizations using Microsoft Teams as their primary collaboration platform that want structured ticketing and agent workflows within the Microsoft 365 environment.


### **Key Features**


- Dual-bot system (Support Bot for employees, Agent Bot for HR staff)
- Teams chat-to-ticket conversion without leaving the app
- Microsoft Entra ID SSO for agents and employees
- Custom ticket forms per department (IT, HR, Facilities)
- Full agent portal accessible entirely within Teams


## **6) Dovetail Software**


Dovetail Software provides HR case management for teams handling employee relations, grievances, disciplinary matters, and compliance-heavy HR processes.


### **Primary Focus**


Dovetail can help HR teams that need structured case management for sensitive employee matters beyond everyday ticket handling. It is more case-management oriented than general Teams ticketing.


### **Key Features**


- AI Copilot for suggested actions and automated responses
- Employee-facing portal with live chat and case tracking
- Employee relations tools for grievances, disciplinary cases, and accommodations
- Full audit trail and GDPR compliance for sensitive cases
- Integrations with Workday, SAP, BambooHR, and ADP


## **7) Tikit (by Cireson)**


Tikit is a Microsoft-native service desk that offers deep integration with the Microsoft 365 ecosystem.


### **Primary Focus**


Tikit focuses on HR requests that need to connect with the broader Microsoft ecosystem including Entra ID, Intune, Power BI, and Power Automate. It supports multi-department ESM across IT, HR, Facilities, Finance, and Marketing.


### **Key Features**


- Right-click message-to-ticket conversion in Teams
- Azure OpenAI Virtual Agent for deflection
- Adaptive Card framework for custom ticket forms
- Power Automate integration for HR onboarding/offboarding automation
- Multi-department service management from one platform


## **8) HappyFox Help Desk**


HappyFox provides help desk and service desk capabilities that can be adapted for HR teams managing requests across multiple channels.


### **Primary Focus**


HappyFox is often considered when HR needs consolidated request handling across channels such as email, Microsoft Teams, and web portals. It can support teams moving away from scattered inboxes and informal request tracking.


### **Key Features**


- Create, respond to, and modify tickets directly from Teams
- Smart rules trigger automated channel notifications
- Schedule Teams meetings directly from tickets
- Ready-to-go chatbots for routine inquiries
- Knowledge base @mention search in Teams
- 14-day free trial available


## **9) Zendesk for Internal Support**


Zendesk is a broad service platform that some organizations adapt for internal HR help desk operations.


### **Primary Focus**


Zendesk is often evaluated when a company already uses it for service workflows and wants to extend similar ticketing practices to HR. It supports multi-channel intake, routing, knowledge base content, and reporting.


### **Key Features**


- Ticketing across email, chat, messaging, and help center channels
- Workflow rules, SLAs, and routing
- Knowledge base and self-service content
- Extensive marketplace for customization
- Integrates with Salesforce, Slack, Jira, Microsoft Teams, and SAP


## **10) Pipefy**


Pipefy combines Teams-based requests with workflow automation built for process-heavy HR operations.


### **Primary Focus**


Pipefy is relevant when HR teams need customizable process automation beyond traditional ticketing. It can support processes such as onboarding workflows, approval chains, hiring pipelines, and policy acknowledgements.


### **Key Features**


- Purpose-built AI agents reduce manual workload
- Customizable workflows to suit varied HR needs
- Extensive reporting and analytics tools
- Teams and Slack integration for multi-channel support
- Visual workflow builder for non-technical users
- Free plan available for small teams

## **Frequently Asked Questions**


### **What is an HR help desk and why is it essential for Microsoft Teams users?**


An HR help desk helps teams manage employee requests through structured ticketing, assignments, and tracking. For Microsoft Teams users, it allows employees to submit requests within their existing workspace instead of navigating to a separate portal. This is particularly important for sensitive HR matters that require privacy and clear ownership. A structured[HR service desk](https://unthread.io/solutions/hr-service-desk?ref=unthread.io) helps teams organize requests, automate workflows, and maintain visibility from intake to resolution.


### **How do purpose-built AI agents improve HR help desk efficiency?**


Purpose-built AI agents automate routine responses, categorize requests, and route tickets to the appropriate HR staff. By referencing approved knowledge base content,[AI agents](https://unthread.io/products/agentic-ai?ref=unthread.io) can resolve common employee questions while escalating complex or sensitive cases for human review. This reduces repetitive administrative work and helps employees receive timely answers. HR teams can then focus on requests requiring personal attention and judgment.


### **Can an HR help desk in Microsoft Teams support employee onboarding and offboarding?**


Yes. HR help desk platforms can coordinate onboarding and offboarding through[automated workflows](https://unthread.io/products/automations?ref=unthread.io) that connect HR, IT, finance, and workplace operations. These workflows help manage account provisioning, equipment requests, approvals, and employee transitions. Automated notifications and task tracking keep stakeholders informed throughout each process. This reduces manual coordination while improving visibility into outstanding tasks.


### **How does a self-learning knowledge base improve HR support efficiency?**


A[self-learning knowledge base](https://unthread.io/products/knowledge-base?ref=unthread.io) helps HR teams identify recurring employee questions and generate draft articles from resolved tickets. It can also highlight documentation gaps, flag outdated information, and organize resources from existing knowledge sources. Employees receive faster answers to common questions, while HR teams spend less time responding to repetitive requests. Over time, these capabilities help maintain accurate documentation and improve employee self-service.
